name: Access Control
description: Controls governing account lifecycle management, authentication (including MFA and SSO), least-privilege access, endpoint device management, and separation of duties.

name: Application Security
description: Controls to prevent application vulnerabilities caused by insecure coding.

name: Backup and Recovery
description: Controls to support backup and disaster recovery.

name: Cryptography, Encryption and Key Management
description: Controls to secure cryptographic protocols.

name: Container Security
description: Controls to secure container building, distribution, and deployment.

name: Datacentre
description: Controls to secure datacentre system components.

name: Data Protection
description: Controls to protect the data of a system.

name: Generative AI
description: Controls for the use of generative AI/LLMs within applications.

name: Human Resource
description: Controls for human resources.

name: Infrastructure Security
description: Controls to secure infrastructure that host applications, services, and data.

name: Logging and Monitoring
description: Controls to support detection and response to security and operations incidents.

name: Network Security
description: Controls to secure the network boundaries of a system.

name: Security Programme Management
description: Controls to implement cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance processes and policies.

name: Resiliency
description: Controls for resiliency.

name: Software Supply Chain
description: Controls to prevent tampering and improve the integrity of the software supply chain.

name: Secure Development
description: Controls to secure the development pipeline and perform source code quality assurance.

name: Security Testing
description: Controls to validate the security of a system via internal and external testing.

name: Baseline Design Practices
description: Controls based on foundational design principles.

name: Performance and Reliability
description: Controls to ensure consistent system performance and dependability.

name: Trust and Legitimacy
description: Controls to establish credibility and build user trust in digital services.

name: Transactions and Payments
description: Controls to enhance and simplify the payments and transactions experience.

name: Understand Users
description: Controls for understanding public users' needs and validating designs with them through user research and usability testing.

name: WCAG - Operable
description: Controls to make interface elements easy to operate for all users.

name: WCAG - Perceivable
description: Controls that ensure users can perceive the content in various forms.

name: WCAG - Robust
description: Controls to ensure content remains accessible across various technologies and assistive tools.

name: WCAG - Understandable
description: Controls to ensure content and user interfaces are clear and comprehensible.
